title: Introduction to Optimization
description:
Prerequisite: One of the following: ENEE290, MATH240, MATH341, or MATH461; and must have completed or be concurrently enrolled in ENEE324 or STAT400.
Recommended: Experience in Matlab or Python.
Restriction: Must be in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering.
Credit only granted for: ENEE464 or ENEE469O.
Formerly: ENEE469O.
